VERDICT
by Ben Hutton
The step up in trip could be the making of the 4yo Pourquoi Pas Papa (second choice) on his second chase start but preference is for TURNDLIGHTSDOWNLOW, who appeals as being well treated judged on his big performance in a novice chase here last month, when he was bang there when unseating at the final fence. Dig Deep may well improve for the switch to fences and is next on the list ahead of Spectacularsunrise, who was 2l ahead when falling at the final fence over C&D last month. Chasing newcomer Crystal Island could also play a leading role, while Four Springs won over fences on his latest start and is also considered.
